newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears Polar IPO for public trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears Polar IPO for public trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) has cleared for public trade the initial public offering of household appliance maker Polar SA, the KPW said in a statement on Thursday.
The firm's 8.9 million existing shares, all belonging to the state treasury, have also been approved for trade. The state will sell 1.845 million of them in a public offering.
IPO Tranches No Of Shares Subscription
State share sale up to 1.845 million Sept 11-17
* State shares to be sold at a minimum price and allotted at special Warsaw bourse session due on September 22.
* IPO price to be arrived at through book-building with price range seen at between 11 and 15 zlotys.
Lead Manager: Bank Handlowy Capital Markets Centre
